visualTestingDecision.reason: W143 only designs the queue enablement switch and result-capture contract. It does not submit the runner, write records, or produce real NetSuite record URLs.

bestNextCodexPrompt.block: W144: Governed Sandbox Queue Submit Pilot Behind Server Flags
bestNextCodexPrompt.prompt: Move through W144: Governed Sandbox Queue Submit Pilot Behind Server Flags. Use the W143 queue enablement design to implement the NetSuite-side server-flagged queue submit path behind CREATE_ENABLED, GOVERNED_SANDBOX_WRITE_ENABLED, QUEUE_SUBMIT_ENABLED, sandbox allowlist, operator approval, idempotency, and result-capture prerequisites. Keep the drawer export/import only and do not add drawer writes or drawer SuiteScript invocation. If flags are false, preserve the W142/W143 dry-run no-submit behavior. If flags are true in sandbox, queue the existing governed runner and return runnerTaskId plus result-capture pending status, not fake record URLs. Output queue submit adapter changes, guarded smoke harness, trace samples, W144 report, targeted visual testing decision, and best next Codex prompt.
